text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai is here. Eishin Flash looks

perfectly calm and collected.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Let's review the top competitors
appearing in this
race.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
First,
Fuji Kiseki. While this distance may
not be her strong suit, she will no doubt
be a difficult
opponent in this race.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Next, Manhattan Cafe. She spoke of
feeling fated to win the upcoming Spring
Shield and is thus
ablaze with
determination to win today.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
They're my most formidable foes. Not
only do they have an affinity with the
course, they also
have impressive track
records.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Today's race could become quite
ferocious.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: Still, does it look kind of fun?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I must admit, my heart is pulsing with

anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's strange. Two months ago, all I felt
for this
moment was fear.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: Looks like you have some breathing...
Looks like you have some breathing...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
After all, I have been training the
correct way all
this time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now I've just got to hold my head high
and keep
running toward my goal!
